faqs.q: How do I know the machine's real condition?
faqs.a: Every machine gets a documented inspection: true hours, a condition report, and a run-off video on request. We would rather lose a sale than ship a surprise.

faqs.q: Do you handle rigging and freight?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate teardown, loading, and nationwide shipping so the machine arrives ready to set. We have shipped to 48 states.
Inspected machines carry a 30-day functional guarantee on the items listed in the condition report. Extended coverage is available on most units.

faqs.q: How do I pick the right tonnage?
faqs.a: Tell us your part size, material, and cavitation and we will point you to the right tonnage and shot-size range, or talk it through on a call.
We work with equipment-finance partners and can provide CMEA/USPAP appraisals your lender will accept.
In-stock machines typically ship within 5 to 10 business days of payment, depending on rigging schedule and destination.
Yes — single machine, full plant, or anything in between. Send photos and a tag plate and we typically return a cash offer within 24 hours.

faqs.q: Will you help with a plant liquidation?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We handle discreet, lender-driven liquidations and full plant moves, including appraisal, rigging, and re-marketing of unsold machines.
